status: PROPOSED 2026-10-31; REVISED 2026-11-01 after the maintainer's independent review (conditionally accepted: 13 types / 5 domains, both modes in both sets, interactive adaptation excluded, reasoning_core / reasoning_gym as training sources only, no sixth domain, D4's weights and search arms unchanged); NOT authorized, NOT run
decided_by: maintainer 2026-10-31 (three briefs): a NEW D4 full search on the hybrid teacher's frozen weights, D4's search specification, the hybrid's own calibration (both modes, balanced on scored positions, reusing v1's sealed trajectories first), references and activations computed from the hybrid; one Top-1 shared by A1 and A2 and both seeds; never D4 Top-1, its rankings, references or weights, never v1's fixed-path initialization

root_teacher.architecture: 36 layers, hidden 2560, 32 Q / 8 KV heads, FFN 9728, head dim 128, RoPE base 1,000,000, 40,960 positions

method.forward_baseline: stage1_init.d1_target_aware.scored_v1@v1 (configs/shared/baselines/selection.json :: selections.initialization -> initialization_forward_baseline_v1.json), resolved through shared.forward_baseline, never copied
free_variables: calibration profile per operator (hybrid Base or hybrid Reasoning-Heavy)
method.candidate_space: each level expands every kept state by each unused operator under each of the two profiles: 8 children at level 1, then beam 6 x (remaining operators x 2); D4's tree was 8 + 48 + 24 + 12 = 92 expansions to 12 complete leaves, and the same schedule gives the same tree size here
method.beam: beam.delayed_prune@v1, width 6, warmup_levels 1 (no pruning at level 0)
method.ranking: beam.pareto_multi_objective@v2: minimize state.teacher_kl.equal_domain_mean, state.teacher_kl.worst_domain, state.critical_token_kl (epsilon 1e-4), tie-break the same keys then state id, diversity key parent_path; NLL diagnostic only
method.positions: positions.supervised_target_v1@v1 (operator selection, state evaluation and ranking alike)
method.support: reference_topk_tail_v1, top-200 + one tail bucket, not renormalized
method.depth_prefix_reuse: on (D4's validated execution; bit-identical scores, removal order and child bytes on the A100 bench, bench_20261019_051316) -- re-validated on the search device (validate_on_search_device true)
method.kl_reference: DEPTH: parent state; state evaluation and ranking: the lineage root, i.e. the HYBRID teacher, recomputed per state (ReferenceStrategy.RECOMPUTE); no Thinking-2507 reference, sketch or logit is read
method.target_geometry: 596,049,920 parameters: 28 layers, hidden 1024, 16 Q / 8 KV heads, head dim 128, FFN 3072, tied embeddings, vocabulary 151,936 (phase_c3 TARGET_GEOMETRY, a3_session.path_spec)
method.commit_rule: stage1_selection.commit: the Pareto quality order's first of the complete leaves is Top-1 (D4's rule, lineage diversity not applied)

profiles.calib.hybrid_d4_base@v1: D4's base weights (0.18 per static axis, 0.28 supporting), 180,000 scored positions, half per mode in every one of the 13 cells
profiles.calib.hybrid_d4_rh@v1: D4's reasoning-heavy weights (0.22, 0.12), the same volume and cells

calibration.rule: per profile, mode and cell: D4's cell order over base_pool_v1 (seed 1308798386) -- the code cell's own prompt list (calibration_code_v1.jsonl) -- the mode's own naturally terminated scored positions, until half the cell's quota (a domain's share split equally over its types, so supporting's 0.28 / 0.12 now over five); a unit refused by R9 (by family name) or whose prompt is a training prompt of either lineage is passed over and the order continues
calibration.reuse: v1's sealed hybrid calibration (D4's 4x prefix) and the supplement's round 0 (801 D4-pool units) first
calibration.coverage_now: configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/hybrid_d4_profiles.json (built from the sealed records): base H-T 92,648 / H-N 83,999, rh H-T 95,415 / H-N 85,084 scored positions; short: string_induction (both modes: R9 removed 33 units of the pool's refused families), code (not generated), rag_evidence H-N
calibration.top_up: the code cell's 9 prompts (calibration_code_v1.jsonl, reasoning_core code modules at seed base 2026310000) in both modes, and the refill units the profile build lists (string_induction 3 H-T + 8 H-N, rag_evidence 2 H-N), one candidate each, v1's rule
calibration.held_out: 33 pool units of R9-refused families (string_induction@v1 str.caesar, str.double_last, str.duplicate_each: D4's own profiles held 4 of them each) and 5,034 pool units whose prompt is a training prompt of A1/A2 (order_v2) or C1 (D4-Augmented's E1 sessions)

state_evaluation.identity: state_eval_hybrid@v1, a NEW suite; state_eval@v1 and its records are unchanged and unused by this search

prompts.by_type: code 22, defined_ops 53, entity_tracking 53, grid_transform 21, gsm8k 73, knights_knaves 21, list_induction 23, multihop_qa 683, openmath 43, ordering 70, rag_evidence 590, scan_language 39, string_induction 31
prompts.sources: fluid: new instances of the same @v1 generators, calibration-split families, seeds 2,500,000-2,570,030 (calibration range; Stage-0's calibration used 2,000,000-2,200,024); gsm8k / rag / multihop: dataset train rows past every row order_v2 holds, corpus_v2's rendering, one question per SQuAD paragraph; openmath: base_pool_v1 units no calibration or training set holds; code: reasoning_core code modules at seed base 2026320000

state_evaluation.quota: 12,000 scored positions per (type, mode), frozen before generation: 13 x 2 x 12,000 = 312,000; each mode takes its type's queue in order until its positions reach the quota (whole units)

scoring.reduction: equal_subtype_then_equal_domain/v1 over sub-types '<type>|<mode>': inside every domain each type and each mode weigh equally, so the modes are 50:50 and a profile's raw tokens confer nothing
scoring.critical_tokens: per mode: H-T think_close, final_answer, eos; H-N final_answer, eos (no </think>: the non-thinking prompt's preclosed think block is prompt, not output). IMPLEMENTED at $0 (2026-11-01): the manifest declares critical_groups {H-T: [think_close, final_answer, eos], H-N: [final_answer, eos]} and every item its critical_group (= its mode); the evaluator then reports state.critical_token_kl = 0.5 x H-T's mean over its classes + 0.5 x H-N's (aadistill.initialization.planning.metrics.CRITICAL_GROUP_AGGREGATION, group_balanced/v1), refuses a class with no scored position in its group, and records the aggregation in the reduction semantics, so the suite's measurement protocol id is new; state_eval@v1's values and ids are unchanged (tests/initialization/test_critical_token_groups.py)
scoring.per_mode_kl: each mode's equal-domain mean, worst domain and critical-token KL recorded beside the ranking values in every state's evaluation (journal), never ranked on alone
scoring.same_suite: every candidate of the search is scored on this one frozen suite, items and weights fixed

manifest: suite_id state_eval_hybrid, version 1; root teacher model, revision and weight-shard sha256; tokenizer files' sha256 and vocabulary sha256; chat template sha256; each mode's template kwargs and sampling
the type table's sha256 and the domain -> sub-type map ('<type>|<mode>'), critical classes per mode, general_domain none

per item: item_id, task id, type, mode, domain, prompt token ids and output token ids (ids = prompt + output), n_prediction_positions, tags (assistant = the generated positions; think_close, final_answer, eos as present in that mode), source lineage (generator, family, seed or dataset row)
counts per (type, mode): items and scored positions

content_sha256 (the item ids' token content, mixture_content_sha256's rule), the structural suite_hash (StateEvalSuite), and the measurement_protocol_id the evaluator derives (suite structure and content, scoring policy, reduction, execution fingerprint)
state_evaluation.loader: a hybrid binding beside the shared loader (scripts/shared/evaluation/load_state_eval.load): it refuses a suite whose manifest does not name this root teacher, tokenizer, template and type table, then loads it; phase_d1's frozen Thinking-2507 binding (d1_session.load_state_eval_suite) is not edited
state_evaluation.generation: the hybrid's own trajectories, one candidate per prompt and mode (the official template, sampling and seeds of generation_protocol.json at a new seed base), only naturally terminated ones are items; H-T on its queue prefix (about 188 prompts), H-N on its (up to 1,722)

mode_combination: ONE initialization: every operator's calibration and every state's KL read one profile whose cells hold equal scored positions of the two modes, and the state objectives average over subtypes '<subtype>|<mode>' before domains: the two modes are weighted equally inside every domain by construction, never searched separately

execution.micro_batch: 1 for the whole search (DECLARED before the run): micro-batch 3 ran out of memory in DEPTH on an L40S with the hybrid root on D4's items (a_check_20261029_190241 :: initialization_mb3.json, 10.99 GiB asked, 44.39 GiB card); micro-batch 1 completed (initialization_mb1.json: DEPTH 2,371 s, peak reserved 26.88 GiB with expandable_segments). Micro-batch is a numerical-execution field: semantic state ids are unchanged, materialization ids and the fingerprint differ from a micro-batch-3 run
execution.alternative: an A100-80GB at micro-batch 3 (D4's own execution profile) only under a separate approval: the L40S measurement above is the evidence
execution.teacher: resident for the whole search (bf16), no offload
execution.persistence: every state's checkpoint and the journal (states.jsonl, telemetry.jsonl) on the network volume after each expansion (prune_weights false); resume replays the journal and restores a state only when its bytes re-identify (BeamSearch._restore); a completed search writes products.json

storage.decision: a network volume holding every state's checkpoint, the journal and the training save points; prune_weights stays false; no candidate evidence is deleted before the evidence audit (maintainer, 2026-11-01)
storage.size: D4's tree stored 274 GB of states; the six trainings' save points add about 50 GB: 350 GB holds both, 300 GB holds both only if non-Top-1 search states are retired after the evidence audit (a maintainer decision, never automatic)
storage.price: $0.07 per GB-month: 300 GB $0.70/day, 350 GB $0.82/day (provider bills have run up to 17% over the rate)

validation_on_the_l40s: already measured (a_check_20261029_190241 :: initialization_mb1.json): DEPTH at micro-batch 1 with the hybrid root on D4's items completes on one L40S (2,371 s, 26.88 GiB peak reserved); micro-batch 3 runs out of memory

owed, in the search session itself and before level 1: every operator (ATTENTION, DEPTH, RESIDUAL_WIDTH, FFN) at micro-batch 1 on both hybrid profiles (level 0 expands all eight), each child's state evaluation on state_eval_hybrid@v1 under its new protocol id, and the Pareto v2 ranking of level 0; the session stops if any operator, evaluation or ranking fails or level 0 overruns its deadline share
